title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Fe Downs on 1982-10-17
lineage: CD (Tascam SS-CDR200) > Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/44.1k) > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC/16
source: (FOB) AUD > Cassette Master > Cassette > DAT > CD

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience recording captures an outstanding first set and a well‑played long second set featuring GDTRFB, Wheel and a Jerry ballad.
ai_review.review: The upgraded AUD source delivers clearer sound than the previous circulating version, letting listeners enjoy an outstanding first set and a lengthy, solid second set (aside from the omitted Brent tune). Reviewers note the rarity of hearing GDTRFB, Wheel and a Jerry ballad together in an ’80s post‑drums segment, suggesting high musical merit for this 1982 show.

ai_rating.rationale: Review highlights a strong performance (high show quality) and an improved but still audience‑sourced recording (good technical quality). Single detailed review gives moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Significant upgrade from the earlier good‑quality AUD; clearer and more balanced but still an audience capture with typical ambient character.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Outstanding first set followed by a long, well‑played second set; post‑drums segment features rare song combination.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's ballad is highlighted in the post‑drums sequence and praised by reviewers.
